findings.issue: ThreadLocal is one slot, not a nested stack; only native RETURN removes it. Exception before RETURN can leave stale scope until next begin; recursive spawnForChunk discards outer scope, nested same-chunk CREATURE local queries can enter localReturns without LocalMobCapCalculator identity or per-category sub-scope.
findings.required_interpretation: Ordinary nonreentrant successful native path correlation is supported; no proof of exception-safe/reentrant or arbitrary-mod-call pairing. Flag missing return or multiple local results as anomalous rather than automatically attributing a one-to-one native call.
